description: Every raw record of one kind in one BandIt import run, sorted by source_key, at most 300 rows, text cut to 300 characters, plus the record's extra fields (fields.*, for example fields.logo_alt or fields.organization_text). Kinds: organization_candidate, prize, person_candidate, schedule_item, venue_fact (bandit-raw-pages), company_facts, venue_place (bandit-raw-orgs), zone, booth_spot (bandit-raw-plan).

configuration.query: FROM bandit-raw-pages, bandit-raw-orgs, bandit-raw-plan | WHERE run_id == ?run_id AND record_kind == ?record_kind | EVAL text = SUBSTRING(text, 1, 300) | KEEP source_key, name, aliases, domain, org_key, tier_text, role_text, location_text, location_norm, start_text, end_text, text, fields.* | SORT source_key | LIMIT 300

run_id.description: The import run id given in the task.

record_kind.description: One record kind, for example organization_candidate or company_facts.
